d:
Aap men se kaee logon ne relve men safar kiya hoga, aur shayad aapke dimag men yah saval bhi aaya hoga ki itni lanbi rel ko aakhir chala kaun raha hai. tren chalane vale ko loko paylat kahte hain. loko paylat ki naukri ke lie kya parhaee karni hoti hai? loko paylat ki naukri men kis tarah zimmedariyan hoti hain? janie kariyar kanekt ke is bar ke episod men.
Prodyusar: kirti rajora aur bharat sharma
Vidiyo: jamshaid ali khan
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
